# FCIRealSpaceDensity

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FCI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FCI/FCIRealSpaceDensity`

```text
FCIRealSpaceDensity, version 0.01

Usage: FCIRealSpaceDensity [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-state : name of the file 
    --degenerate-states : single column file describing a set of degenerate states
    --band-index : index of the band whose occupation has to be computed, -1 if all have to be computed (default value = -1)
    --import-onebody : import information on the tight binding model from a binary file

output options:
```
